source.rights_note: Wikimedia Commons marks the work public domain in the United States (PD-US-expired). Source frames/video are evidence only and are not embedded or redistributed in this specimen.
source.whole_action_inspection: Prior durable Video Motion Pass 010 inspected the coherent 15.000–18.750 s action as pixels before fine timing selection; this repair reuses that source/evidence family and does not claim a fresh source inspection.

contract_test.boundary: Exact repository test logic executed against a successor-only mirror because Standard Chat has no full repository checkout; full-repo-wide regression is not claimed.

iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: Preparation read as mostly translating/sliding mannequin geometry; internal joint intersections also polluted silhouette clarity.
iterations.correction: Separate actor render layers so joints overwrite their own bones but only cross-actor overlap becomes X; deepen K2/K3 into a crooked asymmetrical spring with head/chest trailing pelvis and unequal arm/knee compression.

iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: The recovery counter-arc crossed Actor A at torso/head height and could visually imply an unearned hand contact.
iterations.correction: Raise K7/K8 trailing-arm arc through open negative space above the overlap zone; keep B root moving left so recovery pays debt without reverse recoil or new contact.

iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: Actor A still read as a generic symmetric mannequin, weakening the whole two-body performance even though A root stability was correct.
iterations.correction: Author asymmetrical A limb/COM silhouettes across K0-K8 while holding A root comparatively fixed; label the upper-body reaction INFERRED and explicitly non-impact.

iterations.visible_basis: Ordered 6 fps render sheet of the actual compiled MP4 shows distinct asymmetrical prep, crooked compression, explosive measured-time release, crossing/overlap, overshoot, high trailing-limb counter-arc, and unresolved recovery debt. Root does not reverse to fake recoil; no new contact/support owner is invented.

verdict.TASTE: PASS — phase silhouettes are intentionally unequal and the high counter-arc creates a memorable wake rather than a generic reset.
verdict.FUNCTION: PASS — observed source times remain separate from inferred compile cadence; unresolved support/contact facts stay unresolved; motion is fully carried by abstract ASCII keys.
verdict.CONTEMPT: PASS — predecessor habits rejected: no fake long constraint axis, no equal-spacing tween soup, no symmetric mannequin A, no reverse-recoil/idle reset.
verdict.specificity: B pelvis/upper-body disagreement at K3, K4 release cut, K6 crossing, K7 high lag arc, and K8 recovery debt are individually readable.
verdict.embodied_force_intent: PASS — compression spends into leftward commitment and distal lag pays the cost after root crossing.
verdict.economic_not_cheap: PASS — nine decisive keys plus authored bridge arcs are sufficient; extra frames connect rather than perform.
